Purpose and exclusions

An authored item definition says what an item can be. An owned gear instance identifies one particular item; a stack row stores a quantity. A world pickup or resource node is a separate source, not the owned item itself.

Never bypass the declared rule owner, mutate an authored definition at runtime, trust a client completion claim, or infer a compiled implementation from this page.

Creation and configuration

  1. Create native URPGItemDefinition from PrimaryDataAsset and the catalog resolver; expose authored fields EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly and validation errors.
  2. In Phase 05 define minimal backend item identity records for reward/transfer proof. Author the actual starter material/gear instances in Phase 09, not hundreds of unused shells in Phase 00.
  3. Create DA_Item_CopperOre, DA_Item_AshLog, DA_Item_RiverDace, DA_Item_HealingDraught, DA_Item_IronHatchet, DA_Item_TrainingSword, DA_Item_TrainingShield and DA_Item_WovenCloak as worked examples.
  4. Create WBP_ItemTooltip with name, type, rarity text, requirements, modifiers, binding, durability and comparison fields. Show stat-only equipment clearly when no visual overlay exists.
  5. Reopen catalogs and content validation: every referenced loot/recipe/vendor item ID must resolve before the zone enables that feature.

Required sequence: create native prerequisites -> actual build -> child/data creation -> configure -> assign to listed consumer -> save -> run named fixture. A compiled shell without its consumer assignment is not feature completion.

Lifecycle and cleanup

  1. Construct with only safe defaults; no service calls or world scans from construction scripts.
  2. Inject current owner/definition/session and subscribe once after readiness. Possession and replicated state may arrive in either order; guard initialization.
  3. Accept only permitted commands under current identity/epoch; keep local UI/cosmetic prediction separate from committed state.
  4. After server/backend result apply only matching request generation and nonstale revision; late reply to old body does not mutate new body.
  5. On death, transfer, disconnect, restart or teardown cancel transient work, clear input/timers, unbind delegates and release weak observers. Durable receipts remain authoritative.
  6. On reconnect create fresh runtime objects from current committed snapshot; never deserialize old Actor/widget pointers or rerun initial grants.

Concrete player-to-authority flow

Participation in Item definitions, instances, rarities and generated affixes. Rule owner: URPGItemCatalog. This asset’s role is An authored item definition says what an item can be. An owned gear instance identifies one particular item; a stack row stores a quantity. A world pickup or resource node is a separate source, not the owned item itself.

  1. Content author creates a definition with stable ID, type, stack policy, rarity, level requirements, price basis and optional visual mapping.
  2. A committed loot/craft/shop reward requests an item from an allowed family; server selects a permitted definition/affix outcome and records the resolved result in the command transaction.
  3. Generate one owned UUID for nonstackable gear and persist rolled properties; retries retrieve the stored result rather than rerolling.
  4. Inventory/equipment/bank/trade move the same instance identity and enforce binding/ownership without recreating it.
  5. UI resolves display text/icons/rarity styling from definitions and instance values; it does not compute a new random affix on hover.
  6. Unknown content version blocks unsafe mutation and shows an explicit unavailable-item view; migration maps old IDs without silently replacing rare items.

Named fixture and acceptance

Fixture: ServiceFixture_Items / Item_Gear_A / Item_Stack_Ore. Configure this asset at its first phase and run the linked phase recipe. Actual result: not run in Unreal/backend during documentation generation.

Stimulus / expected result
Replaced item UUID in sell request -> ItemNotOwned or StaleItem; no sale of a different slot occupant.
Affix outside family/range -> InvalidAffix; content or request rejected.
Negative/overflow stack quantity -> InvalidQuantity; no arithmetic wrap.
Unknown definition after patch -> UnsupportedContentVersion and quarantine policy, not data deletion.

Record expected/observed separately. Reopen the concrete map consumer; inspect authoritative state, stable IDs/revisions and UI. Static link checks cannot satisfy this gameplay test.

Common mistakes and staged limits

Do not duplicate a native rule in Blueprint, assume a planned type is compiled, or keep callbacks/owners valid after world or session replacement.

Do not build later references as empty shells in an earlier phase. Source-derived art rows remain blocked by the missing ZIP; plugin API bindings remain blocked by installed-source verification. Placeholder visuals and proposed tuning are explicitly not production proof.
